EXT.evidence: Initiates and elaborately tells a vivid dream to others, taking multiple turns to describe it in detail.

AGR.evidence: Is straightforward and vulnerable about feelings (“I’m not ready to be a father”) and accepts others’ comments without arguing.

CON.evidence: No concrete behavior shows organization or carelessness; the risky dream content isn’t real-world behavior.

NEU.evidence: Shows anxiety and insecurity after a panicky dream (“knew I would not get there in time,” then concludes “I’m not ready to be a father”).

OPN.evidence: Shares an imaginative, metaphorical dream and reflects on its personal meaning regarding fatherhood.
